DVMP_xsec module

gumpgpd.DVMP_xsec.MassCorr(meson: int)[source]

Mass corrections

Parameters:

meson – The meson being produced in DVMP process: 1 for rho, 2 for phi, 3 for j/psi

Returns:

mass correction only for j/psi

gumpgpd.DVMP_xsec.R(Q: float, a: float, p: float, meson: int)[source]

The R ratio: Longitudinal DVMP cross section/ Transverse DVMP cross section

Parameters:

  • Q – The photon virtuality

  • a – Parameter

  • p – Parameter

  • meson – 1 for rho, 3 for jpsi, 2 is saved for phi to use later

Returns: The parametrization of R factor of the L/T separation as in Eq.(32) in https://arxiv.org/pdf/1112.2597”

gumpgpd.DVMP_xsec.R_fitted(Q, meson: int = 1)[source]
gumpgpd.DVMP_xsec.R_rho_cost(a, p)[source]

Cost function for R(Q) using H1 and Zeus data combined.

Parameters:

  • a – Free parameters in the model

  • p – Free parameters in the model

Returns:

(Sum of squared differences between model prediction and experimental data divided by the total errror)/Degrees of freedom

Return type:

Reduced chi2
